title: Choose the Price
description: Inspection is not mastery. Use NightWalker's own Vampire Altar progression and acquire at least one choosable vampire power. Lestat's advice is to choose something deliberately and accept whatever weakness the altar demands. If the choice was already made, the real Nycto owner state is recognized retrospectively.
description_completed: The Overlord has made at least one deliberate Vampire Altar power choice. Lestat's transition guidance is complete; deeper vampire progression remains NightWalker's own system rather than a Questlog imitation of it.

prerequisites.name: Remain within the NightWalker vampire path

objectives.name: Acquire at least one choosable Vampire Altar power

rewards.name: Record completion of Lestat's transition guidance
